usage: The word '單椅' is used to refer to a single chair, often found in living rooms or offices.
It is a countable noun, so you can say '一張單椅' when specifying one chair.
You can use '坐喺單椅上' to describe sitting on the chair.
'單椅' can be used on its own or with adjectives to describe the type or style of chair.
When arranging furniture, you might say '擺多啲單椅喺客廳' to mean adding more single chairs in the living room.
